Restaurant Manager Job at ITM Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        ITM Nigeria Limited - Founded in 2011 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo by Mr Sylva Monga, ITM Holding began as “International Training & Motivation,” focused on training and staff management. As Africa’s business landscape evolved, so did ITM-expanding its services and reach to become a diversified pan-African conglomerate. Today, ITM Holding operates nine companies across 20 countries, employing over 15,000 people and investing in sectors including Human Resources, mining, financial services, logistics, BPO, and more

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Restaurant Manager

Job Location: Wuse 2, Abuja

Requirements
     

            
    




	3–5 years of restaurant or food and beverage management experience.
	Must have strong organisational and multitasking skills in a fast-paced environment.
	Candidate should have a hospitality-first mindset — you understand that people come for more than the food.
	Ability to oversee daily operations across all departments: kitchen, front of house, bar (where applicable), and store/inventory.
	Ensuring consistent high standards of food quality, presentation, hygiene, and service.
	Ability to prepare daily/weekly reports on covers, revenue, stock usage, and team performance.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

title: Account Officer Job at the Vault Recruitment (TVR)
content:
The Vault Recruitment (TVR) is a fast growing recruitment firm specializing in connecting top talent with SME's and Startup organizations. Our team of experienced recruiters understands the unique needs and challenges of the modern job market and uses our extensive network and industry knowledge to find the best candidates for our clients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Account Officer

Job ID: SME0023
Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Work Mode: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Bookkeeper to maintain accurate financial records, record daily transactions, monitor income and expenses, and support the preparation of financial reports.
	The successful candidate will ensure proper financial documentation, assist with account reconciliation, monitor cash flow, and support the company's overall financial accuracy and compliance.


Key Responsibilities


	Record and maintain accurate daily financial transactions.
	Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
	Prepare and maintain invoices, receipts, and payment records.
	Reconcile bank statements and financial accounts.
	Track company income, expenses, and cash flow.
	Assist with preparing monthly and periodic financial reports.
	Maintain organized and up-to-date financial records.
	Monitor outstanding payments and follow up where necessary.
	Support budgeting and financial planning processes.
	Ensure financial records comply with company policies and relevant regulations.
	Assist the Business Manager and management team with financial information and reports.
	Maintain confidentiality of sensitive financial information.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree, HND, or OND in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	2–3 years of experience in bookkeeping or accounting.
	Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good understanding of financial records and basic accounting principles.
	Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
	Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information.
	Experience in retail, e-commerce, or luxury goods is an added advantage.


Salary
N300,000 monthly.    

    

        Click here to Apply

Admin Officer Job at Bevany Resources




        
    

        
        Bevany Resources is a recruitment and human talent support firm dedicated to connecting qualified candidates with forward-thinking employers. We specialise in talent acquisition, candidate screening, interview coordination, and providing recruitment support services to organisations across various industries. Our mission is to ensure businesses build strong teams while helping job seekers find meaningful career opportunities.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Admin Officer

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: Managing Director / Business Development Manager

Role Summary
     

            
    




	The Admin Officer will provide administrative and operational support to ensure smooth day-to-day running of the office, documentation, and coordination between departments.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage office administration, correspondence, filing, and documentation
	Support the BDM with preparation and organization of bid/tender documents and client files
	Maintain records of vendor registrations, certifications, and compliance documents
	Coordinate schedules, meetings, and follow-ups for management and business development
	Handle procurement of office supplies and vendor/contractor payment tracking
	Liaise with external parties (regulatory bodies, clients, suppliers) as needed
	Maintain company database/records (clients, staff, contracts)
	Provide general support across HR, finance, and operations as required


Requirements


	HND / Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or related field
	2 -4 years of administrative experience in the oil & gas or engineering sector preferred
	Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
	Strong organizational and multitasking skills
	Good written and verbal communication
	High level of discretion and attention to detail


Salary
N150,000 - N250,000 / month

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
